title: Roll log record v1 (rolls.jsonl, one per line)
description: One die roll from the mod's hidden roll log (Server/RollLog.lua, roll.since), never shown to the agent. Other fields the mod adds (seq, gt, roller, subject, skill, ability, srcs, ...) are kept and ignored. The luck covariate is computed by bg3bench.luck.

natural.description: the d20 face; null when the source did not see it. On the current game build only passive and skill/ability checks expose it (RequestedRoll); saving throws and attack rolls are always null (live 2026-10-24: no engine source found, research/fix/vis.md R2)

dc.description: the difficulty class; like natural, recorded for passive and skill/ability checks only, null for saving throws and attack rolls on the current build

party.description: the roller is in the party; missing counts as the party's

streams.description: rolls drawn per stream since the previous record
